description: This file defines the class Route53DomainsClient, which extends AwsClient and provides methods to interact with the Amazon Route 53 Domains service, including various domain management operations.

classes.name: Route53DomainsClient
classes.description: Client class for Amazon Route 53 Domains service, extending AwsClient and providing domain management methods.

methods.name: acceptDomainTransferFromAnotherAwsAccount
methods.description: Accepts a domain transfer from another AWS account.

methods.name: associateDelegationSignerToDomain
methods.description: Associates a delegation signer to a domain.

methods.name: cancelDomainTransferToAnotherAwsAccount
methods.description: Cancels a domain transfer to another AWS account.

methods.name: checkDomainAvailability
methods.description: Checks if a domain is available for registration.

methods.name: checkDomainTransferability
methods.description: Checks if a domain can be transferred.

methods.name: deleteDomain
methods.description: Deletes a domain.

methods.name: deleteTagsForDomain
methods.description: Deletes tags associated with a domain.

methods.name: disableDomainAutoRenew
methods.description: Disables auto renewal for a domain.

methods.name: disableDomainTransferLock
methods.description: Disables transfer lock for a domain.

methods.name: disassociateDelegationSignerFromDomain
methods.description: Disassociates a delegation signer from a domain.

methods.name: enableDomainAutoRenew
methods.description: Enables auto renewal for a domain.

methods.name: enableDomainTransferLock
methods.description: Enables transfer lock for a domain.

methods.name: getContactReachabilityStatus
methods.description: Retrieves contact reachability status for a domain.

methods.name: getDomainDetail
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a domain.

methods.name: getDomainSuggestions
methods.description: Provides domain name suggestions.

methods.name: getOperationDetail
methods.description: Gets details about an asynchronous operation.

methods.name: listDomains
methods.description: Lists registered domains.

methods.name: listOperations
methods.description: Lists operations for the account.

methods.name: listPrices
methods.description: Lists prices for domains and related services.

methods.name: listTagsForDomain
methods.description: Lists tags for a domain.

methods.name: pushDomain
methods.description: Pushes a domain to another account.

methods.name: registerDomain
methods.description: Registers a new domain.

methods.name: rejectDomainTransferFromAnotherAwsAccount
methods.description: Rejects a domain transfer from another account.

methods.name: renewDomain
methods.description: Renews a domain registration.

methods.name: resendContactReachabilityEmail
methods.description: Resends the contact reachability verification email.

methods.name: resendOperationAuthorization
methods.description: Resends authorization for a specific operation.

methods.name: retrieveDomainAuthCode
methods.description: Retrieves the authorization code for a domain.

methods.name: transferDomain
methods.description: Transfers a domain to Amazon Route 53.

methods.name: transferDomainToAnotherAwsAccount
methods.description: Transfers a domain to another AWS account.

methods.name: updateDomainContact
methods.description: Updates contact information for a domain.

methods.name: updateDomainContactPrivacy
methods.description: Updates privacy settings for a domain's contacts.

methods.name: updateDomainNameservers
methods.description: Updates the nameservers for a domain.

methods.description: Updates tags for a domain.
